requirement_text: The system must be available as a native mobile application for both Android and iOS platforms.
requirement_reference: "mobile football app that will be available for Android and iOS devices."

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want to access the app on either my Android or iOS device so that I can use it regardless of my phone's operating system.

Acceptance Criteria:
Given I own either an Android or iOS device,
When I visit the respective app store,
Then I can download and install the LiveFootball app.

requirement_text: The system's cold startup time must not exceed 2 seconds on typical modern Android and iOS devices.
requirement_reference: "the app runs quickly and smoothly so that it is fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of two seconds after starting."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want the app to start quickly so that I do not have to wait to access football content.

Acceptance Criteria:
Given the app is not running,
When I launch the app,
Then the dashboard is fully loaded and interactive in 2 seconds or less.

requirement_text: The system must reliably support at least 100,000 concurrent users without any noticeable loss of performance.
requirement_reference: "our app is designed so that up to 100,000 users can be served simultaneously without performance loss."

user_story.user_story:
As a football fan, I want the app to work smoothly even on busy match days so that I receive updates without delays.

Acceptance Criteria:
Given 100,000 users are using the app concurrently during a major match,
When I open any module (news, live ticker, etc.),
Then I experience no slowdown or delayed updates compared to normal usage.

requirement_text: The system must remain functional and allow access to basic features even when the network connection is slow, unstable, or temporarily offline.
requirement_reference: "the app is developed so that it functions reliably even with limited network coverage. The app remains usable offline, even if it temporarily loses connection."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want the app to work even with poor or lost network connection so that I can access information whenever I need it.

Acceptance Criteria:
Given I lose network connectivity while using the app,
When I try to access previously loaded features,
Then the app remains responsive and allows me to view cached content.

requirement_text: The user interface and core module layout must remain stable and consistent even if the app receives updates from the external server or data backend.
requirement_reference: "modules and the user interface are fixed components of the app and remain consistent even with external server updates."

user_story.user_story:
As a regular user, I want the app's interface to stay familiar even when system updates happen so that I do not get confused or lost.

Acceptance Criteria:
Given the data backend is updated,
When I use the app afterwards,
Then the layout and navigation remain unchanged.

requirement_text: The system must undergo thorough pre-release testing and support, and must implement a continuous improvement process by evaluating user feedback and app reviews.
requirement_reference: "app goes through thorough testing and support process before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early. In addition, user feedback and app reviews are continuously evaluated to improve functionality."

user_story.user_story:
As an app owner, I want the app to be released only after thorough testing, and to improve over time using user feedback so that it remains stable and high-quality.

Acceptance Criteria:
Given the app is in pre-release,
When testing is performed,
Then all major issues are found and fixed.
Given user reviews are received,
When recurring issues are found,
Then changes are prioritized and deployed in future updates.

requirement_text: All processing of users' personal data must be in compliance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
requirement_reference: "All personal data of users are processed in compliance with the GDPR."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want my personal data to be handled according to GDPR standards so that my privacy is protected.

Acceptance Criteria:
Given I provide personal information,
When it is processed or stored by the app,
Then all GDPR requirements (e.g., consent, right to deletion, data minimization) are respected and documented.
